packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates of dev tooling and actions once CI is green

All minor and patch updates (npm, Node, actions, digests) in a single PR, after the actions group so it wins for them. Majors keep their own PRs. The type is fix(deps) because the group usually carries runtime dependencies (ws, @companion-module/base) that ship in the module, so release-please cuts a patch release for it. Not automerged when it contains a runtime dependency.

The Companion runtime ships a fixed Node version, @companion-module/base majors change the module API and @companion-module/tools 3 needs base 2 (it fails to build with base 1) – no automatic major bumps, update them by hand together
